message.reasoning_content: "What's the New Mary Jane" — McCartney only? It's credited Lennon-McCartney, recorded with Yoko... Lead vocal: actually Lennon sings? I believe McCartney sings lead on "What's the New Mary Jane"? Hmm. The White Sessions track: John plays piano, vocals Lennon and McCartney. Actually I recall John sang lead. "I Call Your Name" – John. "You Really Got a Hold" – John. "Hello, Goodbye" – Paul only lead. Answer: Hello, Goodbye.
